is not covered under the member's current benefit plan
the patient presents with recurrent episodes of dizziness and giddiness accompanied by transient neurological symptoms suggestive of a transient cerebral ischemic attack
concern for an underlying arrhythmic etiology contributing to these cerebral hypoperfusion events
